description: Save one image from suggest_item_image as the photo on one of your items, straight away. Send the url and the token that came with it. This replaces the current photo; revert_item_image puts the earlier one back. It does not use an image suggestion.

token.description: The token returned with that image

url.description: The url of one image returned by suggest_item_image

name: apply_item_image
title: Apply item image
